architecture: residual: train-only SVD16 standardized latent features; closed-form Ridge latent model-difference embedding; residual uses tanh and fixed0.25 correction on Ridge1
target: continuous empirical delta; residual target uses inner3-fold group OOF base predictions; all ties retained
uncertainty: conditional residual bootstrap; base Ridge, representation and OOF targets held fixed; not calibrated full predictive uncertainty
selection: fixed fold-local allowlists; no tuning or early stopping on outer outcomes
decision: argmax mean quality, exact prediction tie -> large
primary: 400 selected-panel repeated quality; BestSingle and DatasetBest identical on single-dataset MMLU panel
secondary: 2975 historical objective temp0 transfer; replace only MMLU decisions; nonMMLU keep fold DatasetBest for learned routers
limits: Not an independent test; original test exposed
Historical transfer and repeat panel use different outcomes; do not mix gap denominators
Fixed3 seeds all reported; no winner seed selection
